# OptimalX UX audit and spec, 2026-09-24

Designer S6c. Walked live at `http://localhost:3210` on 2026-09-23 with chrome-devtools-mcp at **1440 x 900** and **390 x 844 (dpr 3, mobile emulation)**, in Arabic and on the `/en` mirror. Every measurement below is read off the running page (`evaluate_script`, `lighthouse_audit` snapshot, bounding boxes, computed styles), not asserted from source, except where a row says "source". Binding inputs: `docs/build/DIRECTION.md`, `docs/build/X-IDENTITY-2026-09-22.md`, `docs/brand/voice-ksa.md` sections 6 and 7, `docs/build/research/FINAL-claims-source.md` section 3, `docs/build/NAV-2026-09-23.md`, `docs/build/CARD-2026-09-23.md`, the S3d to S5c handbacks.

Conventions: every user facing string is a locale key. New keys ship in `locales/partials/s6c.ar.json` and `locales/partials/s6c.en.json` and are mirrored identically into `locales/ar.json` and `locales/en.json` (`tests/i18n.test.ts` forbids a partial disagreeing with the base). No literal Arabic in `app/`. Western digits. No combining marks, no dialect, no em dash in any shipped string.

---

## The five biggest confusion risks

1. **The cart is a 500 page.** `/ar/cart` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')` inside `<CartComponent>` and renders the engine's raw error screen with untranslated keys (`common.errors.500`, `common.elements.back_home`), under a document title that reads `common.titles.cart`. Every add to cart in the store ends here. Nothing else in this audit matters more.
2. **The advisory the whole brand rests on cannot be bought.** On the branch visit booking product (`/ar/x/p1051830221`) there is no book button at all: the element reading `اطلب الخدمة` is a `<p class="ox-service__slot-note">`, and the real control is the Raed scaffold's form with English labels (`Weight 0.1`, `Quantity`), a total of `0`, and a quantity input and add button that render as permanently pulsing `s-skeleton` blocks. The free InBody measurement that the home band promises is never mentioned on that page.
3. **On a phone the product page's two purchase controls sit on top of each other.** At 390 `.ox-buy__now` occupies x 16 to 219 at y 288 and `salla-quantity-input` occupies x 17 to 135 at y 290: the orange `اشتري الآن` parallelogram covers the quantity stepper, and the add button is squeezed to 91 px so its label `أضف إلى السلة` is clipped away and only a glyph that reads as a bin remains.
4. **`/ar/services` renders zoomed out on a phone.** `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` is **721** against a 390 viewport, and `window.innerWidth` reports 721, which means the device has scaled the whole page to about 54 %. Proven cause, tested live: `.ox-compare__scroller` is `position: static`. Setting it to `relative` in the page collapsed the document to 390 immediately; reverting restored 721. This is the exact failure the render budget names.
5. **The visitor keeps reading the same words for different things.** Two adjacent home sections are both headed `تصفح المزيد`; `عرض الكل` appears **12 times on the home page pointing at 12 different URLs**; the breadcrumb's second crumb on a product page is a page the visitor never chose and links back to the product itself; and `الأسئلة الشائعة` in the footer opens `/services`.

---

# P0, a visitor would be confused or blocked

### P0-1. The cart route crashes
**Where:** `/ar/cart`, 1440 and 390.
**Visitor:** They press add to cart, open the cart, and get a grey `500` with the words `common.errors.500` and a button labelled `common.elements.back_home`.
**Fix:** In `app/routes/cart.tsx`, the cart component reads `.length` off an undefined value before the cart store resolves. Guard every list read with a default (`const items = cart?.items ?? []`) and render the `EmptyState` (DIRECTION 5.6) while `cart` is undefined rather than falling through to the engine boundary. Give the route a real head: `ox.titles.cart` (ar `السلة`, en `Cart`) in `app/components/seo/head.ts` so the document title is never `common.titles.cart`. Replace `CatchBoundary` for this route with `app/components/pages/ErrorState.tsx` so a failure shows the OptimalX error state with `الرئيسية`, `اسأل قبل أن تشتري` and the WhatsApp row (DIRECTION 5.6 ErrorState) instead of the engine default.
**Console evidence:** `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length') The above error occurred in the <CartComponent> component`, plus `Warning: Error in route match: /{-$locale}/cart/ar/cart`.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.6 (EmptyState, ErrorState), 6.9 (Cart composition).

### P0-2. The booking product page has no way to book
**Where:** `/ar/x/p1051830221` (branch visit), 1440 and 390.
**Visitor:** They read a clear description of a free branch visit, reach the bottom, and find a note that says "order the service" with nothing to press, an English `Weight 0.1` row, an English `Quantity` row and two grey pulsing bars where the button should be.
**Fix:** In `app/components/product/variants/ServicePdp.tsx`, render the buy control the spec already describes instead of falling through to the engine form: a 48 tall primary button wrapping `SallaAddProductButton` with the booking product type, label `ox.pdp.book_now` (ar `احجز الآن`, en `Book now`) for booking products and `ox.pdp.order_service` (ar `اطلب الخدمة`, en `Request the service`) for service products; the existing `ox-service__slot-note` becomes the note under it and must read `ox.pdp.slot_at_checkout` (ar `تختار موعدك في صفحة إتمام الطلب.`, en `You pick your time at checkout.`). Suppress the engine's `Weight` and `Quantity` rows on `product_type` `booking` and `service` (they are physical shipping fields and mean nothing here): add `.ox-pdp--service .ox-buy .sticky-product-bar, .ox-pdp--service .ox-buy section:has(.product-weight) { display: none }` in `app/styles/06-ox/_b3-product.scss`, or better, do not mount the engine form for those types at all. Add the InBody row to the facts card, gated on the existing `inbody_included` setting, key `ox.content.services.visit_inbody` which already exists.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.5 ServicePdp, 6.6 blocks 5 to 9; FINAL-claims-source section 2 row 10 (the InBody line is a measurement, never an outcome).

### P0-3. The mobile buy row overlaps itself
**Where:** `/ar/x/p1673105563`, 390. Measured: `.ox-buy__now` x 16 w 203 h 48 at y 288; `salla-quantity-input` x 17 w 118 h 40 at y 290; `salla-add-product-button` x 284 w 91 h 52 at y 284 with `clip-path: polygon(35.1px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 35.1px) 100%, 0 100%)`.
**Visitor:** The orange "buy now" bar sits on top of the quantity stepper; the add to cart button is a small rhombus with a bin looking glyph and no words.
**Fix:** In `app/styles/06-ox/_b3-product.scss` make the PDP buy zone one grid at 390: row A the quantity stepper at 120 x 44 flush to the inline start, row B `أضف إلى السلة` full width 358 x 48, row C `اشتري الآن` full width 358 x 48, 12 gap between rows, `.ox-buy__actions { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 12px }` and `.ox-buy .sticky-product-bar { position: static; padding: 0; background: none }` so the engine section stops competing for the same y. Drop the parallelogram from any control under 146 px of inline size: `ox-run(48px)` is 32.4 and X-IDENTITY 2.4's floor is `run / 0.24` = 135, so the 91 px add button is illegal on the identity document's own terms; give it `border-radius: var(--ox-r-2)` and the full label.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.4 BuyRow; X-IDENTITY 2.4 (the `run / 0.24` floor) and 3.3 (one angled gesture per component block).

### P0-4. `/ar/services` renders the whole page zoomed out on a phone
**Where:** `/ar/services`, 390. Measured `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` 721 and `window.innerWidth` 721. Live experiment: setting `position: relative` on `.ox-compare__scroller` returned both to 390; reverting returned both to 721.
**Visitor:** The services page opens at about half scale, the header and footer are wider than the screen, the page pans sideways and every tap target is half size.
**Fix:** `app/styles/06-ox/_b5-pages.scss:338`, add `position: relative;` to `.ox-compare__scroller` (it already has `overflow-x: auto`, `scroll-snap-type: inline proximity` and a sticky first column, all of which need a positioned containing block). Add the same rule to any future scroller and keep the assertion in the test suite: every element with computed `overflow-x: auto|scroll` must compute `position: relative`.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 10.1, the G2 scroller addition, verbatim: "an absolute descendant of a static scroller belongs to `<body>`, widens the document, and a phone renders the whole page zoomed out".

### P0-5. Untranslated lookup keys are visible to shoppers
**Where:** `/ar/cart` document title `common.titles.cart`; `/ar/brands` breadcrumb `common.titles.brands` (measured: breadcrumb text `الرئيسيةkeyboard_arrow_leftcommon.titles.brands`); `/ar/blog` document title `blocks.footer.blog`; the cart error page body `common.errors.500` and `common.elements.back_home`. 1440 and 390.
**Visitor:** They see programmer text where a page name should be, on the brand index and in the browser tab.
**Fix:** `app/components/common/OxBreadcrumb.tsx` already has `isUnresolvedKey()` and rewrites unresolved keys, but `app/components/brands/BrandsIndex.tsx` builds its own trail without it; route every breadcrumb through `OxBreadcrumb`. For titles, `app/components/seo/head.ts` and `app/components/seo/routeHeads.ts` must never pass a platform bundle key to `title`: add the three missing theme keys `ox.titles.cart` (ar `السلة`, en `Cart`), `ox.titles.brands` (ar `العلامات التجارية`, en `Brands`), `ox.titles.blog` (ar `الأدلة`, en `Guides`) and use them. Add a test that fails the build when any rendered `<title>` or breadcrumb label matches `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z0-9_]+)+$/`.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 9.2 (page titles per route), the same class of defect `OxBreadcrumb.tsx`'s own docblock already documents.

### P0-6. The product breadcrumb names a page the visitor never chose, and links to itself
**Where:** `/ar/x/p1673105563`. At 1440 the trail read `الرئيسية › الطاقة › شيكر اوبتيمال اكس V2`; the crumb `الطاقة` carried `href="/ar/x/p1673105563"`, the product's own URL. At 390, after visiting `/ar/branch`, the same crumb read `مكملات غذائية في المدينة المنورة: فرع الخالدية`.
**Visitor:** The back path says they came from "Energy" (or from the branch page) when they came from protein, and pressing it reloads the same product.
**Fix:** `app/components/common/OxBreadcrumb.tsx` builds the fallback trail from `page.parent`, which the engine fills with the last visited page. On the PDP, build the trail from the product's own taxonomy instead: in `app/components/product/ProductPage.tsx`, pass an explicit `breadcrumbs` array of `[home, the product's first category from app/content/taxonomy.ts, the product name]`, falling back to `{ name: t('ox.nav.all_types'), url: '/categories' }` when the product has no category. In `OxBreadcrumb`, drop any crumb whose `url` equals the current route URL before rendering, so a self link can never ship again.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.3 Breadcrumb; NAV-2026-09-23 section 8 (one link resolution rule).

### P0-7. The branch has no hours, no map and no way to reach it, while the copy promises all three
**Where:** `/ar/branch` and the home `ox-branch` block, 1440 and 390. Source check: in `twilight.json`, `branch_address`, `branch_hours`, `branch_map_url`, `branch_landmark`, `pickup_ready_hours`, `pickup_hold_days` and `reply_sla_hours` all have `"value": null`. `app/components/pages/BranchPage.tsx` already imports `BranchMap` and `PickupSteps`; both self hide when their setting is empty.
**Visitor:** The branch page's own opening paragraph says "the address and the opening hours are here", and then there are no opening hours, no map, no photograph, a one row FAQ, and a card headed "book a time for your visit" with nothing to press. The home branch block is a bare 184 px card with a WhatsApp button and no link to `/branch` at all.
**Fix:** This is a settings gap, not a code gap. Fill the defaults in `twilight.json` so the shipped theme renders the facts the store already owns: `branch_address` = `حي الخالدية، شارع جبار بن صخر، المدينة المنورة`, `branch_hours` (the owner's real weekly table), `branch_map_url` = the owner's map link for 24.46276125, 39.653138015, `branch_landmark`, `pickup_ready_hours`, `pickup_hold_days`. Leave `reply_sla_hours` and `delivery_promise_line` empty until the owner has the staffing and the carrier agreement (FINAL-claims-source section 2 rows 3 and 6). Two code changes go with it: in `app/components/pages/BranchPage.tsx` make the intro sentence that promises hours conditional on the same gate as the hours table, key `ox.branch.intro_with_hours` (ar `... والعنوان وساعات العمل هنا.`, en `... the address and opening hours are here.`) versus `ox.branch.intro_no_hours` (ar `... والعنوان هنا، وللمواعيد راسلنا على واتساب.`, en `... the address is here; message us on WhatsApp for times.`); and in `app/components/home/OxBranchBlock.tsx` add a secondary link `ox.branch.view_page` (ar `صفحة الفرع`, en `Branch page`) to `/branch` beside the WhatsApp button, plus today's hours line when the setting is set. Make the branch page's "احجز وقتا لزيارتك" card a real link to the branch visit booking product.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.2 OxBranch, 6.12 blocks 3 to 6; FINAL-claims-source section 6 (the branch is the store's one named proof).

### P0-8. The `/en` hero is not mirrored: the text sits on the photograph and a third of the band is empty
**Where:** `/en`, 1440. Measured: `.ox-hero__photo` x 0 w 929 with `clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 377.7px 100%)`; `.ox-hero__text` x 66 w 596, entirely inside the photo's box; `.ox-hero__edge` x 522 w 488 **h 694 inside a 560 band**; two `.ox-band__wedge.ox-hero__wedge` at x -50 and x 4.
**Visitor:** The English home page opens with the headline and body copy printed over the athlete and the creatine tub, an orange diagonal slashing across the middle of the photograph, and an empty black third on the right.
**Fix:** `app/styles/06-ox/_b2-home.scss`, the `[dir='ltr']` hero block. Mirror the panel, not only the polygon: the photo pane takes `inset-inline-end: 0` in LTR so it sits at the end (the left in RTL, the right in LTR) and the text column takes columns 1 to 5 at the start. Restate the polygon rather than reusing it, per X-IDENTITY 2.5: the run must be 202.4 of an 864 pane (23.4 %), not 377.7 of 929 (40.7 %), and the edge is vertical to 46.43 % then leans. Use the two declarations the identity document prints verbatim: RTL `polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 46.43%, 76.57% 100%, 0 100%)`, LTR `polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 23.43% 100%, 0 46.43%)`. The strap `.ox-hero__edge` is a 12 px parallelogram with `inset-block: -2.14%` (block size 324 for a 300 lean), not 488 x 694. Move or remove the two corner wedges that land at x -50 in LTR.
**Follows:** X-IDENTITY 2.3 (the 24 % run budget, exceeded by a factor of 1.7 here), 2.5 (the hero edge, exactly); DIRECTION 9.8 (polygons: both declarations present, photo panels never mirrored with `scaleX`).

### P0-9. The product page prints its own spec table twice, once as an unreadable run-on
**Where:** `/ar/x/p1673105563`, the `الفوائد` section, 1440 and 390. Measured text: `الفوائدتفاصيل المنتجالقيمةالسعة820 مل (28 أونصة)المادةبلاستيك خال من BPA والفثالاتكرة الخلطفولاذ مقاوم للصدأالغطاءلولبي مع فتحة قابلة للإغلاقغسالة الأطباقآمن في الرف العلوي`.
**Visitor:** Below a perfectly readable details table they meet the same facts again as one unbroken string with the column headings glued to the values.
**Fix:** In `app/components/product/BelowFold`, the benefits block is being fed the raw description HTML that still contains the table `parseSpecLine` already consumed. Strip the first `<table>` from the description before rendering the benefits prose (the same node `specLine.ts` parses), and if nothing is left, do not render the `الفوائد` section at all. Never render a table as a text node.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.4 NutritionTable (the table is a real table with a third explanation column), 6.5 block 15.

### P0-10. "Buy now" does not buy
**Where:** every product card on every route, and the PDP, 1440 and 390. Measured: `.ox-card-product__buy` is an `<a href="https://optimalx.com.sa/...">` to the product page. `can_quick_buy` is false on all 47 products (CARD 4.3 records this).
**Visitor:** They press an orange button that says "buy now" and land on the product page, where they must press again.
**Fix:** In `app/components/product/OxProductCard.tsx`, when `can_quick_buy` is false the control must not say `ox.card.buy_now`. Render `ox.card.view_product` (ar `اعرض المنتج`, en `View product`) in the secondary face instead, and reserve the accent filled `اشتري الآن` for the case where Salla's quick buy is actually on. On the PDP keep `اشتري الآن` only where `SallaQuickBuy` mounts. This is the "steps the visitor cannot predict" rule, and it also removes one of the two competing calls to action on every card.
**Follows:** voice-ksa 3.7 (a verb the reader does on a control); CARD-2026-09-23 section 4.3.

### P0-11. Two consecutive home sections carry the same heading
**Where:** `/ar` and `/en`, 1440 and 390. Measured heading order: `... أحدث المنتجات`, then `تصفح المزيد` on `s-block--ox-posters`, then `تصفح المزيد` on `s-block--ox-products-secondary`. The second block's four cards all carry saving badges (19 %, 20 %, 18 %, 51 %).
**Visitor:** They scroll past "Browse more", then immediately past "Browse more" again, and cannot tell that the second one is the discounted products.
**Fix:** Two new keys in `app/components/home/defaults.ts` and the locale partial. Posters keep a heading that names what they are: `ox.home.posters_title` (ar `ابدأ من هنا`, en `Start here`) with the descriptor `ox.home.posters_lead` (ar `أبواب مختصرة إلى الأهداف والأنواع والخدمات.`, en `Short doors into goals, types and services.`). The secondary product rail becomes `ox.home.offers_title` (ar `العروض`, en `Offers`) with its `عرض الكل` pointing at `/offers`, and it renders only while `settings.show_offers_nav !== false`, the gate NAV 1.3 already defines. Nothing in either heading may claim a discount that the badge does not already carry.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.2 SectionHeader and the A4 amendment; NAV-2026-09-23 section 9 (no two anchors with the same visible text pointing at different URLs).

### P0-12. The InBody line says two different things on one screen and is missing where it is bought
**Where:** `/ar` and `/ar/services`, the advisory band, 1440 and 390. Measured, the only two occurrences on the site: `يشمل قياس تكوين الجسم (InBody) مجانا في الفرع.` inside the `زيارة الفرع` card, and `قياس تكوين الجسم (InBody) مجانا في الفرع مع الاشتراك.` under `برامج وخطط تدعم هدفك`. The booking product page contains no occurrence.
**Visitor:** One card says the measurement is free at the branch; the line under it says it is free with a subscription; and the page where the visit is actually booked never mentions it.
**Fix:** One sentence, one meaning, three places. Rewrite `ox.content.services.visit_inbody` to ar `قياس تكوين الجسم (InBody) مجانا في الفرع مع زيارة محجوزة أو مع اشتراك.` / en `Free InBody body composition measurement at the branch, with a booked visit or with a subscription.` and make `ox.home.band_inbody_plans` reference the same key rather than restating it. Render it in the facts card of `app/components/product/variants/ServicePdp.tsx` for the branch visit product, gated on `inbody_included` (already `true` by default in `twilight.json`). The noun stays `قياس`; no `تشخيص`, `فحص`, `تحليل`, `قراءة نتائج` or `تفسير`, and no outcome, number or timeframe attached.
**Follows:** FINAL-claims-source section 2 row 10 and its detail paragraph; voice-ksa 6.3.

### P0-13. The pack supply calculator runs on things that are not consumed
**Where:** `/ar/x/p1673105563` (a shaker bottle), 1440 and 390. Rendered: `كم يوم تكفي العبوة؟` with `تكفي حوالي 1 يوم` and `تنتهي تقريبا في 2026-09-24`.
**Visitor:** A reusable bottle is described as lasting one day and running out tomorrow.
**Fix:** In `app/components/product/BuyZone`, gate `SupplyCalculator` on the product being consumable, not merely on `servings` being a number: require `spec.servings >= 2` **and** a `form` value in the consumable set from `app/content/taxonomy.ts` (powder, capsule, tablet, softgel, bar, liquid). Accessories, gift cards and bookings never render it. The same gate removes the nonsense `عدد الحصص: 1` row from the accessory details table.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.4 SupplyCalculator ("hidden when the spec line has no servings"; the copy rule "describes the package, never a person").

### P0-14. Twenty four links per page leave the build and drop the locale
**Where:** `/ar`, 390: **24 of 58 anchors** resolve to `https://optimalx.com.sa/...`. By component: `ox-goal` 6, `ox-card-product__title-link` 8, `ox-btn` (the card buy control) 8, plus two more. At 1440 the same pattern covers every rail's `عرض الكل` and every brand tile.
**Visitor:** In the preview they leave the site; in production every one of these is a full page reload instead of a client navigation, and an English visitor is thrown back into Arabic.
**Fix:** `app/components/layout/navLinks.ts` already exports `toPath`, `toSafeLinks` and `withLocale`, and S3d applied them to the five header surfaces. Apply the same three helpers in `app/components/home/OxGoals.tsx` and `GoalCard.tsx`, `app/components/product/OxProductCard.tsx` (title link and buy control), `app/components/home/OxCategoryRail.tsx` and `OxProductsSecondary.tsx` (`عرض الكل`), `app/components/brands/BrandsIndex.tsx` and `BrandPage.tsx`, and `app/components/listing/GoalLanding` (the sub need cards, which currently point at `https://optimalx.com.sa/pre-workout/c9003`). Add the test NAV section 11 item 21 already specifies, widened from the header to the whole document: no anchor anywhere may resolve to an absolute `https://optimalx.com.sa/...` URL, and every one carries the active locale segment.
**Follows:** NAV-2026-09-23 section 8 (one link resolution rule); S3d deviation 3, which flagged `OxGoals` as left as found.

### P0-15. The primary button label fails AA, and the owner has already been told
**Where:** every accent filled control on every route. Lighthouse (snapshot, mobile, `/ar`, 390) scores accessibility **88** with one real failure: `div.ox-hero__actions > a.ox-btn > span.ox-btn__label`, "insufficient color contrast of **3.59** (foreground `#ffffff`, background `#f54915`, font size 12.8pt (17.1px), font weight bold). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1." The other two Lighthouse failures are inside Salla's preview bar and are not ours.
**Visitor:** The store's main call to action, on the hero, on every card, on the PDP, on the services band and on the branch block, is below the legibility floor in daylight.
**Status, recorded rather than re-litigated:** `app/styles/tokens.css:228-235` documents this as an **owner override of 2026-09-23 03:30**, "the orange CTA is the global primary button", with the 3.59:1 figure written into the comment. It is a decision, not an oversight, and this gate does not overturn it.
**Fix, the one that keeps the owner's look and clears AA:** raise the label past the large text floor instead of changing the colour. `app/styles/06-ox/_primitives.scss:92`, `--ox-btn-primary-size: calc(19px * 0.9)` gives 17.1px; `calc(21px * 0.9)` gives **18.9px**, which is over WCAG's 18.66px bold floor, so white on `#F54915` becomes legal at 700 weight with no token change. Where a control is too narrow to carry an 18.9px label (the 390 card buy button at 77 px and the hero at 390), scope `--ox-on-accent: var(--ox-ink)` to that control only: `#12171E` on `#F54915` measures 5.01:1, which is what DIRECTION 2.2 and CARD 6.3 already specify. Whichever of the two the owner picks, record it on the token line; do not ship the current pairing at 17.1px.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 2.2, 9.3 (primary button, blocker at rest); CARD-2026-09-23 section 6.3.

### P0-16. The mobile hero photograph is a poster with its own text cropped off
**Where:** `/ar`, 390. The hero photo box is 390 x 300 and the source image is a pre-composed marketing banner: Arabic fragments (`...ثر.`, `...ضل.`, `دعم القوة`, `...ل العضلي`) and English labels (`MOR...`, `BETT...`) in circular badges run off the inline end of the frame.
**Visitor:** The first thing on the phone is half a sentence in two languages bleeding off the screen, above the real headline.
**Fix:** Replace the mobile hero source with a photograph that carries no text, per the asset brief in DIRECTION 8.1 (`hero-home-mobile.jpg`, 1200 x 1600, 3:4, subject centred, face in the top 35 %, both bottom corners empty, no signage, no captions, one orange object). Until that file exists, use the desktop hero's own crop, which has no text in frame, and set `object-position: center top`. The rule that failed here is in the brief's own preamble: "No text anywhere: labels are plain, screens are out of focus, no signage, no captions."
**Follows:** DIRECTION 8 (imagery rules), 5.2 OxHero (mobile: photo full bleed with a linear gradient, text pinned to the bottom).

### P0-17. `/ar/about` returned the 404 page on a full load
**Where:** `/ar/about`, 1440, navigated from `/ar/branch`: the 404 rendered and the document title fell back to `Optimal X`. On a later full load at 390 the page rendered correctly, and a direct `fetch('/ar/about')` returns 200 with the right title.
**Visitor:** The footer's `من نحن` link, which is the only route to the founders' story, sometimes lands on "page not found".
**Fix:** Reproduce first. The likeliest cause is the same route match failure the cart shows (`Warning: Error in route match: /{-$locale}/cart/ar/cart`), a locale segment being concatenated twice in the optional locale route. Check `app/routes/about.tsx` and the `{-$locale}` route tree, and add a route test that loads `/ar/about`, `/en/about`, `/ar/cart` and `/ar/branch` cold and asserts the page component, not the notFound component, mounts. If it cannot be reproduced, record it and move on; do not ship a 404 on the story page.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 6.15, 9.2 (one h1 per route, page titles).

### P0-18. The contact page promises a channel it does not offer
**Where:** `/ar/contact`, 1440 and 390. Measured: no `@` anywhere in `main`; the document title is `تواصل معنا: واتساب وبريد وهاتف وفرع`; the written question card says the team replies `كتابة على بريدك`.
**Visitor:** The tab says the store has email, the service says the reply arrives by email, and there is no email address anywhere.
**Fix:** Either render the email row in `app/components/pages/ContactPage.tsx` (a 72 tall channel row, `dir="ltr"` on the value, key `ox.contact.email_label` ar `البريد الإلكتروني` / en `Email`, value from a new `contact_email` theme setting), or remove `وبريد` from the route head in `app/components/pages/head.ts` and change the written question reply line to name the real channel. Do not ship the promise without the address.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 6.16 block 3; voice-ksa 6.1 rule 1 (never turn ordinary language into a promise that is not backed).

# P1, guidance, curation and recommendation cues missing where a visitor decides

### P1-1. There is no way to narrow a category
**Where:** `/ar/protein/c9001` (14 products, then 32 on search), `/ar/goal-energy/c9020`, `/ar/search`, 1440 and 390. Measured: zero `aside`, zero filter trigger buttons, no price input, no brand facet. The only controls are a `رتب حسب` select and a row of child category chips.
**Visitor:** They land on fourteen protein products and can only sort; they cannot ask for isolate under 300 riyals, or only the brand they trust.
**Fix:** Ship the `FiltersRail` that DIRECTION 6.3 block 4 already composes: a 280 wide sticky column from 1024 with applied chips, `مسح الكل`, and three groups that the current catalogue can actually populate from real data, **brand** (from `product.brand.name`), **form** (from `parseSpecLine`), **price** (two inputs `من` and `إلى`, 44 tall, `dir="ltr"`, plus the range track). Below 1024 the same content lives in a drawer opened by a 44 tall secondary trigger in the listing header, with the active count in a pill and a sticky footer `عرض N منتجا`. No facet may be rendered with a count the loader has not returned.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.3 FiltersRail, 6.3 block 4, 6.4 block 7.

### P1-2. Search never says how many results there are, and "show more" looks like a dead control
**Where:** `/ar/search?q=بروتين`, 1440. Measured: the count line reads `عرض 16 منتج` while 16 cards are on the page and a `عرض المزيد` button is enabled; pressing it loads 16 more and the line becomes `عرض 32 منتج`, still with no total and still with the button enabled.
**Visitor:** They cannot tell whether they have seen everything, and the button looks like it does nothing until they press it.
**Fix:** In `app/components/listing/ListingPage.tsx`, the progress line takes the total: `ox.listing.showing_of` (ar `عرض {shown} من {total}`, en `Showing {shown} of {total}`), `aria-live="polite"`. When `shown === total` replace the button with `ox.listing.all_shown` (ar `هذه كل النتائج`, en `That is all of them`). Never render an enabled `عرض المزيد` with nothing behind it.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.3 LoadMore, 9.5 (status messages are `aria-live` polite).

### P1-3. A search for a category name does not offer the category
**Where:** `/ar/search?q=بروتين`, 1440 and 390. The query matches 32 of the 47 product catalogue, including tortilla chips, peanut butter, oats, collagen and L-arginine, because the word appears in their descriptions.
**Visitor:** They search for the word on the shop's own menu and get a near random half of the shop.
**Fix:** This is the store's cheapest real guidance and it uses only data the theme already holds. In `app/components/listing/ListingPage.tsx`, before the grid, when the normalised query matches a `name` or a synonym in `app/content/taxonomy.ts`, render one 56 tall panel: `ox.search.category_hint` (ar `تبحث عن قسم؟ افتح {name} مباشرة.`, en `Looking for a section? Open {name} directly.`) with a secondary link to that category. Add the dialect forms `وش هدفك` and `وش احتاج` to the synonym list, which voice-ksa 6.2 names as the one sanctioned place for dialect (input understanding, answered in MSA).
**Follows:** voice-ksa 6.2; FINAL-claims-source section 3 (no invented relevance, only the taxonomy the store owns).

### P1-4. The zero results page tells the visitor to send a message and gives them no way to send it
**Where:** `/ar/search?q=zzzz`, 1440 and 390. The line `لم تجد ما تبحث عنه؟ أرسل لنا اسم المنتج ونخبرك إن كنا نوفره.` is plain text with no link or button.
**Visitor:** They are asked to do something and given no control to do it with.
**Fix:** In `app/components/listing/ZeroResults`, make that line a row with a secondary 44 tall WhatsApp button, label `ox.search.tell_us` (ar `أرسل اسم المنتج على واتساب`, en `Send the product name on WhatsApp`), `href` the store WhatsApp with the query prefilled in the `text` parameter. Also replace the headphone glyph that currently stands as the figure with the OptimalX mark at 48 in `--ox-plate-2`, which is what the spec asks for and what the 404 page already does.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.3 ZeroResults, 4.3 of X-IDENTITY (the mark as the empty state figure).

### P1-5. Nothing anywhere says how many products a door leads to
**Where:** `/ar/categories`, the mega panel, the shop sheet, the home type tiles and the home goal cards, 1440 and 390.
**Visitor:** They open `كرياتين` expecting a section and find two products; they open `أوميغا 3 والزيوت` and find two.
**Fix:** The count is real data and is already on the brand tiles, so use it consistently. Add a count to `app/components/home/CategoryTile.tsx` and the `/categories` type cards, small 600 in `--ox-fg-3` at the end of the label strip, key `ox.common.product_count` with correct Arabic number agreement: `{n, plural, =1 {منتج واحد} =2 {منتجان} few {# منتجات} other {# منتجا}}` / en `{n, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}`. The same string replaces the brand tiles' current `منتجات: 7` and the listing header's `عرض 14 منتج`, both of which are ungrammatical today. Show no count where the loader has not returned one; never estimate.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 5.2 CategoryTile (optional count small `--ox-fg-3` at the end); FINAL-claims-source section 3 (no invented statistics).

### P1-6. The mobile home is eighteen screens long and buries everything that makes the store different
**Where:** `/ar`, 390. Measured `document.body.scrollHeight` **15,390 px** (18.2 viewports). Block heights: `أحدث المنتجات` 2,071, `تصفح المزيد` (posters) 369, `تصفح المزيد` (offers) 1,080, `تصفح حسب النوع` 1,182, then **eight** `ox-category-rail` blocks at 601 each (4,808 px), then the services band 2,014. The branch block (268) starts past 12,600 and the FAQ (371) past 14,000. At 1440 the same page is 14,127 px.
**Visitor:** They scroll through eight near identical rows of two or three products each, most of which they have already seen higher up (the shaker, the electrolyte tablets and the chlorophyll each appear in three separate blocks), and never reach the branch or the FAQ.
**Fix:** In `app/components/home/defaults.ts`, cut the eight per type rails to **three**, chosen by real product count from `app/content/taxonomy.ts` (protein 8, vitamins 5, collagen 4), and render a rail only when its category holds **four or more** products; below that it is a chip, not a rail. Move `ox-branch` and `ox-faq` above the type rails, so the physical proof and the honest answers sit inside the first six screens. Remove a product from a rail when it already appeared in `أحدث المنتجات` or the offers rail on the same page. Target: under 9,000 px at 390.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 6.2 (the default composition budgets about 6,300 px at 390); the owner brief's "we curate".

### P1-7. `عرض الكل` appears twelve times on one page pointing at twelve different places
**Where:** `/ar`, 1440. Measured: 12 anchors with the visible text `عرض الكل`, resolving to `/ar/latest-products`, `/ar/categories`, `.../protein/c9001`, `.../creatine/c9002`, `.../pre-workout/c9003`, `.../amino-acids/c9004`, `.../omega-3/c9005`, `.../vitamins-minerals/c9006` and more. The services band's own primary call to action is also labelled `عرض الكل`.
**Visitor:** Every section ends with the same two words, and a screen reader's link list is twelve identical entries.
**Fix:** `app/components/common/SectionHeader.tsx` takes the destination's name: `ox.common.view_all_named` (ar `كل {name}`, en `All {name}`), so the protein rail reads `كل البروتين` and the brands strip reads `كل العلامات التجارية`. The services band's button stops being `عرض الكل` and becomes `ox.services.view_all` (ar `كل الخدمات والاشتراكات`, en `All services and subscriptions`). The poster tiles keep one shared verb only if they point at the same URL as their own card, which they do not, so they take the named form too.
**Follows:** NAV-2026-09-23 section 9 (no two anchors on one route carry the same visible text pointing at different URLs); DIRECTION 5.2 SectionHeader.

### P1-8. The goal page repeats its own opening sentence and sends two of three needs to the same page
**Where:** `/ar/goal-energy/c9020`, 1440 and 390. Measured: the hero sub line and the first sentence of the intro block are byte identical. The three sub need cards resolve to `.../pre-workout/c9003`, `.../pre-workout/c9003?chip=بدون منبهات` and `.../daily-health/c9008`, and all three carry the link text `عرض`.
**Visitor:** They read the same sentence twice within one screen, then choose between two cards that land on the same listing.
**Fix:** In `app/components/listing/GoalLanding`, the hero renders the first sentence and the intro block renders the **remainder**, which is exactly what DIRECTION 6.4 block 3 specifies ("the hero carries only its first sentence, so nothing is repeated"); split the string in `app/content/goals.ts` at the first sentence boundary rather than printing it twice. Give each sub need card a link text that names its destination, key `ox.goal.need_cta` (ar `اعرض {name}`, en `Show {name}`), and make the second card's chip a real applied filter with a visible applied chip on arrival, so the visitor can see why the two pages differ.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 6.4 blocks 2, 3 and 5; 5.3 SubNeeds row.

### P1-9. The services comparison table, the best guidance device on the site, has holes in it
**Where:** `/ar/services`, 1440. Measured: the `التغذية والمكملات: من أين تبدأ` column has an **empty price cell** and an empty `التعديل والإلغاء` cell; `جلسة تدريب شخصي 60 دقيقة` has an empty `ما يصلك بعدها` cell. The band above it is headed `ثلاث طرق تسأل بها` while the table compares five services and the page details five.
**Visitor:** They compare five services and two of them have no price and no cancellation policy; and the page told them there were three.
**Fix:** In `app/content/services.ts`, every service carries all four comparison fields or it is not in the table. Fill the two missing prices (or `مجاني` where free) and the missing cancellation rule. Change the band heading from a count to a category: `ox.home.band_ask_title` becomes ar `طرق تسأل بها` / en `Ways to ask`, and the plans row keeps `برامج وخطط تدعم هدفك`, so no heading promises a number the page does not deliver. Add a booking link in each table column head so the comparison ends in an action.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 6.11; S5c deviation 1 (the sixth card's identity change is already recorded and is correct).

### P1-10. The brand index sorts Latin names under Arabic letters and never prints the Arabic name
**Where:** `/ar/brands`, 1440 and 390. Twenty one tiles, each a logo image plus `منتجات: N`, grouped under `ا ب ث ج د س ف ك م ن`, with no name text in the tile.
**Visitor:** To find Optimum Nutrition they have to know it is filed under `ا` (اوبتيموم), and a tile whose logo has not loaded is anonymous.
**Fix:** In `app/components/brands/BrandsIndex.tsx`, print the brand name under the logo plate, 40 tall, 14/600, in a `<bdi lang="en">`, and show the Arabic transliteration in `--ox-fg-3` under it where `app/content/taxonomy.ts` has one. Keep the Arabic letter index but label it: `ox.brands.index_label` (ar `حسب الحرف العربي للاسم`, en `By the Arabic spelling`). Add a Latin A to Z strip beside it, since every brand in the catalogue has a Latin wordmark.
**Follows:** DIRECTION 6.14 (tiles: logo contained on a plate, **name 40 under it**); 3.4 (Latin islands isolated with `bdi` and `lang="en"`).

### P1-11. The footer leaves out the store's positioning, its branch, its brands, its guides and its policies
**Where:** every route, 1440 and 390. Measured footer links: `من نحن`, `تواصل معنا`, `واتساب`, `الأسئلة الشائعة` (which points at `/ar/services`), four of the ten type roots, six goals, Instagram.

Column `خدمة العملاء` gains `الأسئلة الشائعة` pointing at the FAQ route (not `/services`), plus `سياسة الاستبدال والإرجاع`, `سياسة الخصوصية`, `الشحن والتوصيل` from the engine's static pages. Column `عن اوبتيمال اكس` gains `اسأل قبل أن تشتري` (`/services`), `فرع المدينة المنورة` (`/branch`), `العلامات التجارية` (`/brands`) and `الأدلة` (`/blog`). Column `المنتجات` carries all ten roots plus `كل الأنواع` to `/categories`. Add the payment marks row, the trust badges row and the VAT and CR block that DIRECTION 5.1 Footer specifies, each rendering only when its value is filled.

### P1-12. The sticky buy bar shows a price with no product
**Where:** `/ar/x/p1673105563`, 390, after the buy row leaves the viewport. Measured: `.ox-sticky` fixed at top 779, 390 x 65, containing only a full width `أضف للسلة`. The tab bar correctly unmounts under it.

**Where:** `/ar/brands/9101` bottom (`استكشف المزيد`: Centrum, Sports Research, Olimp, Isopure, EVLution, Optimum, Nuun, NOW Sports, NeoCell, Nature's Way, then بروتين, كرياتين, الفيتامينات, الكولاجين, الصحة اليومية, سناكات, الأحماض), and `/ar/protein/c9001` where the child chips (`واي بروتين`, `بروتين كازين`) use the identical `ox-chip ox-chip--filter` class as the cross type chips (`كرياتين`, `ما قبل التمرين`).

### P1-14. `/categories` opens a second door to the services with a different name
**Where:** `/ar/categories`, the `الحزم والخدمات والمنتجات الرقمية` row, 1440 and 390. One of the four cards is `الاستشارات والخدمات`.

**Where:** `/en`, 1440 and 390. Measured card text: `الطاقة` with `Pre-workout, electrolytes`, `الصحة العامة` with `Multivitamin, omega 3, vitamin D`, and so on for all six.

**Where:** `/ar`, 390, with the shop sheet open (measured `.ox-wa` fixed at x 322, y 724, 52 x 52, `z-index: 100`, still painted over the sheet at `z-index: 300`) and with the mobile drawer open, where it covers the `المفضلة` row.

**Where:** `/ar`, 1440, every product card. Measured on `.ox-card-product__add .s-button-element`: `font-size: 12.5874px`, weight 600.

# P2, polish

### P2-1. An eyebrow that repeats its own heading
`/ar` and `/ar/brands/9101`, 1440: `العلامات التجارية` sits above `تسوق حسب العلامة`, and `العلامات التجارية` sits above the brand name on the brand banner. DIRECTION amendment A4 is explicit: an eyebrow renders only when it states a fact the heading lacks. Remove both, and with them the 24 by 2 accent rule. On the brand banner, replace the eyebrow with the product count and the brand's own one line description where `app/content/taxonomy.ts` has one. Named tell: "eyebrow labels above a heading that carry no information". **Follows:** DIRECTION 9.1 A4, 9.9.

### P2-2. An off palette accent word in the footer
Every route, 1440 and 390: in `رتب اختيارك وتقدم نحو هدفك` the word `هدفك` renders `rgb(63, 163, 122)`, a green that exists in no token (`--ox-go` is `#0F7B4F`). It is also the named tell "single word headline accents". Remove the span in `app/components/layout/Footer`, or if the emphasis is wanted, carry it in weight (700) and not in a colour. **Follows:** DIRECTION 2.5, 9.9 (named tells).

### P2-3. The breadcrumb wraps to three lines on a phone
`/ar/x/p1673105563`, 390. DIRECTION 5.3 Breadcrumb requires "a horizontal scroller on mobile so long trails never wrap to three lines". Add `overflow-x: auto; position: relative; white-space: nowrap` to `.ox-crumbs` below 1024, and keep the 44 hit height on each link. **Follows:** DIRECTION 5.3, 10.1 (scroller rule).

### P2-4. The branch FAQ has one row
`/ar/branch`, 1440 and 390: a single accordion row reads as a rendering error rather than a list. Add the two rows DIRECTION 6.12 block 6 names (parking, and paying in store), and the Ramadan hours row once `branch_hours` is filled. Keys `ox.branch.faq.parking_q/a`, `ox.branch.faq.pay_in_store_q/a` in both locales. **Follows:** DIRECTION 6.12.

### P2-5. Three empty full viewport fixed layers at rest
`/ar`, 390: `SALLA-LOCALIZATION-MODAL`, `SALLA-OFFER-MODAL` and `SALLA-LOGIN-MODAL` each compute `position: fixed`, 390 x 844, `visibility: visible`, `opacity: 1`, transparent, `pointer-events: none`, empty. They cost nothing to paint today, but three permanently laid out full viewport fixed boxes are exactly what the budget rations. Add `salla-localization-modal:not(.is-open), salla-offer-modal:not(.is-open), salla-login-modal:not(.is-open) { display: none }` to the engine overrides. Everything else in the probe is clean (see the measured section below). **Follows:** DIRECTION 10.1 rules 5 and 6, 10.2.

### P2-6. Two angled gestures on the goal card
`/ar`, 390: the goal card carries the orange corner strap at the top inline end **and** a chamfer at the bottom inline start. X-IDENTITY 3.3 is enforced, not advised: one angled gesture per component block. Keep the top strap, square the bottom corner in `app/styles/06-ox/_b2-home.scss`. **Follows:** X-IDENTITY 3.3.

### P2-7. Arabic number agreement on every count line
`/ar/protein/c9001` `عرض 14 منتج`, `/ar/brands/9101` `عرض 7 منتج`, `/ar/goal-energy/c9020` `عرض 6 منتج`, and every brand tile's `منتجات: 7`. All are ungrammatical. Ship the single plural aware key from P1-5 and use it everywhere a count is printed. **Follows:** voice-ksa 3 (MSA, correct forms); DIRECTION 3.3 (Western digits, units follow the number).

### P2-8. A route named after sales with no sales data
`/ar/most-sales-products` resolves with the title `كل المنتجات`. Either retire the route from the shop route set in `app/components/layout/navLinks.ts` until real order data exists, or keep it and title it honestly, `ox.titles.all_products` (ar `كل المنتجات`, en `All products`), which is what it already shows. Never label it `الأكثر مبيعا`. **Follows:** FINAL-claims-source section 3 (no "the most sold" until real order data exists).

### P2-9. A banned verb in a service description
`/ar/x/p1051830221`: the description contains `الحجز يضمن أن يكون طلبك جاهزا`. `يضمن` is on the banned lexicon verbatim. Rewrite in the allowed verb family: ar `مع الحجز نجهز طلبك ونخصص لك أحد أعضاء الفريق في الوقت الذي اخترته.` / en `With a booking we prepare your order and set aside a team member at the time you chose.` **Follows:** FINAL-claims-source section 4; voice-ksa 6 ("مضمون is banned verbatim") and 6.1 rule 3.

### P2-10. The services page repeats its own h1 as a hidden h2
`/ar/services`: an `h1` and an `h2` both read `اسأل قبل أن تشتري`. S5c flagged this and left it. Give the intro section its own accessible name, `ox.services.intro_label` (ar `لماذا تسأل قبل أن تشتري`, en `Why ask before you buy`), or remove the hidden heading. **Follows:** DIRECTION 9.2 (headings order, no hidden decorative headings); S5c deviation 6.

### P2-11. Two payment marks render as broken images
`/ar/x/p1673105563`, 390: `tabby_mini.png` and `tamara_mini.png` return `naturalWidth: 0` from the Salla CDN transform URL. Verify in production before spending effort; if they fail there too, host the two marks locally on a `--ox-paper` plate 32 tall, per DIRECTION 5.1 Footer's payments rule. **Follows:** DIRECTION 5.1, 9.6 (explicit dimensions on every image).

### P2-12. The carousel cue buttons and the first tile
`/ar`, 1440: the posters rail's first tile is clipped by the viewport edge rather than aligned to the container start, and on the zero results rail the prev and next circles paint on top of the first and last card images. Set the rail's scroll padding so the first item is flush with the container start (DIRECTION 9.8, scrollers), and move the arrows into the section header row on desktop, which is where the spec puts them. **Follows:** DIRECTION 5.2 ProductsSliderWrapper, 9.8.

### P2-13. The `/categories` type grid is ragged
`/ar/categories`, 390 and 1440: eight tiles render at 232 x 348 and two (`الإكسسوارات`, `سناكات وبروتين بار`) render at 208 x 167, so the rows do not align and the mobile two column layout staggers. Give every tile the same reserved slots (image plate, label, one line descriptor clamped to two lines, optional chip row kept at height when empty) and `align-items: stretch` on the grid. **Follows:** DIRECTION 4.4 (a row where one card is taller than its neighbour is a G2 failure).

### P2-14. The about stats row breaks when one stat has no number
`/ar/about`, 390: the three stats are `1 / فرع`, `(no number) / الشحن`, `2 / شريكان`, and the middle one leaves a hole in the row. Either give the shipping stat its number (the count of cities is not known, so use none) and drop it from the numeric row into the lead sentence, or reserve the numeral slot at full height for all three. **Follows:** DIRECTION 6.15 block 3, 4.4.

---

## Measured and found sound (so the builder does not re-open them)

These were probed and pass; do not "fix" them.

- **Render budget at 390 on `/ar`**: zero `backdrop-filter` roots, zero `filter` elements in `app/` (the only two are inside the TanStack devtools overlay), zero forced layers (no `will-change`, no `translateZ`), zero fixed elements past the viewport, `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` equals 390, `html` and `body` backgrounds both `#FFFFFF` and matching the route ground. The `.ox-util__trust--scroller` fix from S3d has landed: no OptimalX scroller computes `static` on `/ar`, `/ar/categories` or `/ar/protein/c9001`. The one static scroller in the whole walk is `.ox-compare__scroller` on `/services` (P0-4).
- **Equal height**: product cards measure exactly 620 on every row at 1440 on `/ar/protein/c9001` and `/ar/search`, and 479 on every row at 390. CARD 4.4 holds.
- **Header hierarchy**: exactly six nav items at 1440 with the destinations NAV 1 specifies; the mega panel is 1296 wide, aligned to the container, no focus trap, real headings, child links at 6.35:1.
- **Shop sheet and drawer**: the sheet mounts full height, the tab bar unmounts under it, focus moves to the close button, `modal-is-open` is set, and the drawer traps focus with `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`. Two taps reach every goal and every root type.
- **The PDP sticky bar** appears correctly once the buy row leaves the viewport (top 779, 65 tall) and correctly replaces the tab bar.
- **The 404 page** is the best designed state on the site: the mark, the display headline, the search field, three routes out and a WhatsApp link.
- **The zero results page** carries real guidance (spelling hint, term chips, goal chips, a popular rail) and invents nothing.
- **Claims discipline** holds everywhere I looked: no ratings, no review counts, no countdowns, no delivery promise, no `الأكثر مبيعا`, no `موزع رسمي`, and the honest scope lines are present on the services band, the services page and the branch visit product.

## What this gate could not judge

Salla's cart, login and checkout cannot complete offline, so the handoff was read from markup and copy only. The icon sprite is mid redraw, so glyph quality is excluded; the one icon finding I kept is semantic rather than visual (the zero results figure is a headset, where the mark is specified). Chromium does not evict compositor tiles under these budgets, so the clean probe above is evidence the surfaces sit inside the numbers, not that the owner's phone is clean; G4 still measures the built output.
